lead: Best practices and published research from ACTLC member universities. Each document opens as a PDF in your browser.

items.title: Research-Integrated Teaching: Bridging Scholarship, Leadership Practice, and Student Research
items.summary: How Dr. Ahmadi teaches her own published research on the leadership knowing-doing gap in the MBA course MGMT 513, and how the session led two students to build their theses on it.

items.title: Scholarship of Teaching and Learning: Teaching Innovations, Learning Resources, and Publications
items.authors: Prof. María del Mar de Fez Laso
items.summary: Her teaching methods, including the Inquiry–Reflection–Communication framework, Stand-Up Teaching and Learning Checkpoints, plus College Algebra exercise banks and science outreach publications. Each entry links to the full text.

items.title: CoDesignS Education for Sustainable Development: A Framework for Embedding Education for Sustainable Development in Curriculum Design
items.authors: Norita Ahmad, Maria Toro-Troconis, Mohammed Ibahrine, Rose Armour, Victoria Tait, Katharine Reedy, Romas Malevicius, Vicki Dale, Nathalie Tasler and Yuma Inzolia
items.summary: A framework for building sustainability into university courses in any subject. It was tested with academics, curriculum designers, students and government officials, who found it easy to use.

items.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence and the Education Sector
items.authors: Norita Ahmad, San Murugesan and Nir Kshetri
items.summary: What ChatGPT and other large language models mean for universities: how institutions are responding, ways to deal with plagiarism, and assessment strategies that still work.
